items.informal_name: Infimum Less Than iff Existence in Non-Empty Finite Set
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf' H f < a ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i < a
items.informal_description: For a non-empty finite set $ s $ of elements in $ \beta $ and a function $ f : \beta \to \alpha $ where $ \alpha $ is an infimum semilattice with a top element $ \top $, the infimum of $ f(s) $ is less than $ a $ if and only if there exists an element $ i \in s $ such that $ f(i) < a $. Formally, $ \bigwedge_{b \in s} f(b) < a \iff \exists i \in s, f(i) < a $.

items.informal_name: Element Less Than Infimum iff Less Than All Elements in Finite Set
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  a < s.inf' H f ↔ ∀ i ∈ s, a < f i
items.informal_description: For a non-empty finite set $ s $, a function $ f : \beta \to \alpha $ where $ \alpha $ is a linearly ordered set (and thus a distributive lattice), and an element $ a \in \alpha $, it holds that $ a < \inf_{b \in s} f(b) $ if and only if $ a < f(b) $ for every $ b \in s $.

items.informal_name: Infimum of Function on Finite Set is Less Than a iff Some Element is Less Than a
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderTop α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf f < a ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b < a
items.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ and a function $ f : \beta \to \alpha $ where $ \alpha $ is an infimum semilattice with a top element $ \top $, the infimum $ \bigwedge_{b \in s} f(b) $ is less than $ a $ if and only if there exists an element $ b \in s $ such that $ f(b) < a $.

items.informal_name: Infimum over Non-empty Finite Set is Less Than or Equal to a iff Exist Element with Image Less Than or Equal to a
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf' H f ≤ a ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≤ a
items.informal_description: For a non-empty finite set $ s $ and a function $ f : \beta \to \alpha $ where $ \alpha $ is an infimum semilattice with a top element, the infimum of $ f(s) $ is less than or equal to $ a $ if and only if there exists an element $ i \in s $ such that $ f(i) \leq a $.

items.informal_name: Strict Inequality with Minimum Element iff Less Than All Elements
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : LinearOrder α] (s : Finset α) (H : s.Nonempty) {x : α}, x < s.min' H ↔ ∀ y ∈ s, x < y
items.informal_description: For a non-empty finite set $ s $ in a linearly ordered type, an element $ x $ satisfies $ x < \min(s) $ if and only if $ x $ is strictly less than every element $ y \in s $. Formally, $ x < s.\min' H \leftrightarrow \forall y \in s, x < y $, where $ H $ witnesses the non-emptiness of $ s $.
